_note: Roots, never repos. What is inside a root is answered by the filesystem at the moment it is asked, so this file cannot go stale the way a list of repos would. Same reasoning as Marquee's venue.json and Mains' mains.json.
_depth: How many folder levels below the root to descend looking for .git. A repo found part-way down is NOT pruned -- the scan keeps going, because ~/.claude is a repo that contains another repo (Pet), and stopping at the first hit would hide it.
